description: This PHP source file defines the AdministrationViewThemesettings class, which handles theme settings administration in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for processing form submissions, checking permissions, and rendering the theme settings page.

classes.name: AdministrationViewThemesettings
classes.description: A class extending SugarView to manage theme settings in the administration panel, including form processing and rendering.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the module title parameters used in the UI, including a link to the administration index.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles form submissions for theme configuration, validating user permissions and input, then updating configuration accordingly.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the theme settings page, verifies user permissions, prepares theme data for rendering, and outputs the settings template.
